bio: This warm and welcoming place exudes a charming liveliness. The terrace overlooking the lake is an absolute delight. Complementing the inviting ambiance is a delectable selection of regional cuisine. An appealing array of fresh, flavoursome dishes awaits, ranging from braised veal cheeks to game and fish from Tegernsee. Most of the ingredients are sourced locally. At lunchtime there is a speciality menu. Maier zum Kirschner Hotel proposes pretty guestrooms imbued with Alpine charm....
